If the ②nd effect of <<12090>> was activated as Chain Link 1, <<4861>> can be activated when it would be Tribute Summoned.

If the ②nd effect of <<12090>> was activated as Chain Link 2 or higher, <<4861>> cannot be activated when it would be Tribute Summoned.
